title: Prompt-Pay Recognition on Genetic Self-Pay Quotes: Training Questions
content:
These questions cover how a patient's payment record with Patient Invoices & Statements affects the genetic self-pay quote on a Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class.

**Q. What record is read?**
A. The patient's invoice activity in the 24 months before the quote date: the payments received and the payments reversed.

**Q. What does a patient with a good payment record receive?**
A. When the activity shows at least two payments received in those 24 months and no payment reversed, the quote is reduced by the prompt-pay discount percentage of the Self-Pay Patient Invoice billing class, taken of the test price sum.

**Q. And a patient with a single payment?**
A. When the activity shows exactly one payment received and no payment reversed in those 24 months, the quote is reduced by a fixed credit of **10.00**, whatever the test price sum.

**Q. What about a reversed payment, or no payments at all?**
A. Any other payment record, including one with a reversed payment, brings no prompt-pay reduction.

| Payments received in the 24 months | Payments reversed in the 24 months | Quote reduced by |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | None | The Self-Pay Patient Invoice prompt-pay discount percentage of the test price sum |
| Exactly one | None | 10.00 |
| Any number | One or more | nothing |
| None | None | nothing |

**Q. Worked case (hypothetical: a Self-Pay Patient Invoice prompt-pay discount of 2 percent, a test price sum of 500.00).**
A. With three payments and no reversal, the quote is reduced by 2 percent of 500.00, that is 10.00. With one payment and no reversal, it is reduced by the fixed 10.00. With three payments and one reversal, there is no prompt-pay reduction.
